text: Sinne Men muuyuno, Men waɗayno o nafitora ɗen Aayeeje Men ɓamtira mo ɗe gollitirgol ɗe, ko woni tun, o suɓike dakammehoy aduna, o jokki mbeleeɗe makko. Sugu makko e tiiɗude rerɗangol aduan, si sifa rawaandu lahayndu tuma kala ; foti ndu ronndi maa hara ndu ronndaaki. Ko ɗum woni misal yimɓe fennooɓe Aayeeje Amen ɗen. Fillano ɓe qissaaji ɗin -an Nulaaɗo- ; belajo'o, ɓe miijitoto ɓe yalta e majjere e fennugol.
